Mr. Surapong Laoha-Unya

CEO of MOVE

CEO of MOVE business and CEO of Bangkok Mass Transit System Public Company Limited (BTSC – the leading rail mass transit operator), Mr. Laoha-Unya is a nationally recognised expert in the rail mass transportation field and has been in the transportation industry for several decades.

Mr. Laoha-Unya holds a M.M.E in civil engineering. He has substantial experience from his career as a consulting engineer for several international organisations, specialising in mass transportation. He was also served as an advisor to Tanayong Public Company Limited (former name of BTS Group) for the bidding the first SkyTrain project in Thailand. He currently serves as an advisor to the Academic Subcommittee of Traffic and Transportation Engineering Programme of the Engineering Institute of Thailand.

Currently, BTS Group has also been actively engaging in large-scale transportation projects -beyond rail mass transportation. His related extensive experience in leading rail mass transit in Thailand is the core asset which can be leveraged in other exciting non-rail projects under BTS Group.
